prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity 1440×900 desktop web-app concept for PulseRank Product Passport
Primary request: Design the “Prism Rail” composition as a shippable enterprise product-passport interface. A complete left hero bay is devoted entirely to the supplied Mega Monster Energy Drink can at generous scale, with the full can silhouette visible and uncropped. The right side is one spacious editorial measurement field. A single thin glossy amethyst vertical glass rail structurally divides the two halves; the huge “240 mg” measurement optically crosses and anchors to this rail. The rail is the composition’s sole luminous gesture. One quiet top action dock contains only “Compare” and “Open source”. A single full-width lower ledger has exactly four columns in this order: “Product metadata”, “Observed facts”, “Source record”, “Ranking eligibility”.
Input images: Images 1–4 are style, material, and typography references only. Image 5 is a content and product-can reference and a visual anti-reference: preserve the real Mega Monster can appearance and trusted facts, but discard its steel typography, industrial framing, and card composition.
Scene/backdrop: dark-only graphite-black desktop interface, deep, clean, and straight-on; no white page, device frame, background blobs, or environmental scene.
Style/medium: realistic shippable desktop product UI mockup, not concept art; enterprise capital-markets-grade restraint; exacting spacing, strong negative space, crisp focal data, subtle translucent glass, restrained polished highlights. Components should visually map only to shadcn primitives, Magic UI Shine Border or Number Ticker, and Aceternity Spotlight New, while reading as one authored interface rather than a component catalog.
Composition/framing: full 1440×900 viewport, straight-on screen capture. Complete left product hero bay; thin vertical amethyst prism rail at the structural split; open right editorial field; 240 mg intersects the rail without becoming a chart or progress indicator; action dock above the field; four-column ledger visible across the full lower width. Strong left-to-right scan. No bento grid and no repeated rounded cards.
Typography: wide neo-grotesk editorial sans-serif; huge thin-to-regular numerals; confident mixed case; clean tabular numerals in the ledger; sharp readable text. Absolutely no condensed industrial stencil, monospace costume, all-caps-everywhere styling, or blurred typography.
Color palette: graphite black, cool white, and rare neon glossy purple/amethyst caustic light only. No olive, yellow, green haze, or rainbow gradients.
Materials/textures: powder-coated graphite, clear smoked glass, and one narrow glossy amethyst glass rail with a precise caustic highlight. At rest, suggest only one rare settled light sweep along the rail; no other motion effects.
Text (verbatim where rendered): “PulseRank”, “Product Passport”, “Mega Monster Energy Drink”, “240 mg”, “Caffeine”, “per serving”, “709 ml serving”, “33.9 mg / 100 ml”, “320 kcal”, “81 g sugar”, “Compare”, “Open source”, “Product metadata”, “Observed facts”, “Source record”, “Ranking eligibility”, “Caffeine Informer”, “Observed 22 Aug 2026”, “Eligible for caffeine ranking”, “Eligible for sugar ranking”, “Energy drink”.
Constraints: All essential product understanding and labels must be sharp and readable without depending on color, blur, imagery, or motion. Preserve the actual supplied product-can recognition asset and its complete silhouette. Treat these facts as immutable: Mega Monster Energy Drink; 240 mg caffeine per serving; 709 ml serving; 33.9 mg / 100 ml; 320 kcal; 81 g sugar; source Caffeine Informer; observed 22 Aug 2026; eligible for caffeine and sugar ranking. Do not invent measurements, scores, targets, charts, ranks, source claims, ingredients, health guidance, recommendations, medical language, or additional products. Use no trust score and no hotlinked URL text. Render only the settled rest frame.
Avoid: generic dashboard cards, bento grids, repeated rounded cards, progress bars, progress rings, charts, invented scores, medical or target claims, olive or yellow, text blur, illegible copy, background blobs, neon cyberpunk styling, crypto or finance content, steel framing, screws, scanlines, condensed type, stencil type, monospace costumes, all-caps everywhere, excessive glow, watermark.
